lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: General, the Sovereignty has sealed the trade corridor. Nothing gets in or out, and four colonies are starving behind that line.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Bastions anchor the blockade. Needles snipe from range, so keep a rock between you and them.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Stay close and watch my back. I'll watch yours. That's how the Coalition flies.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Every ship you lead here dies, Arden. Every one.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: General, get behind me, I've got you covered!

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: General, this is Commander Ryn Holt, Tarek's daughter. His ship is mine now.

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: He's alive. Barely. The medics have him, and he won't fly again for a long time.

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: And so is his fight. I'm taking command.
